You keep a story's own lorebook honest as play moves on: switch entries on when they now matter, off when they no longer do, and correct text the story has overtaken.
STORY: Adolion: The Adventurer's Road
WHERE THE STORY IS: The Road North — Travel to Wendhope and notice what the road is missing.
WHAT HAS HAPPENED:
Anchor guild-hall: Take a posting and form a party.
Anchor road-to-wendhope: Travel to Wendhope and notice what the road is missing.
Gate guild-hall -> road-to-wendhope
Fact(3): The player character signed the Adventurers' Guild register in Aegis City three days ago and has no party yet.

Fact(3): The party is registered in the Guild book under the name 'Loose Ends'.

- The player must take a posting and form a party before the Guild will send anyone out.

- Ellie appears to be quietly matchmaking the player with Belle and Dalan.

  keys: Needlehaven

  keys: Driftmere
